---
title: "Read PCB concentrations from large tables"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
remotes::install_github(c("ropensci/tabulapdf"))
# usethis::use_package("daiR")
# usethis::use_package("tesseract")
# usethis::use_package("googlesheets4")
# usethis::use_package("dplyr")
library(magrittr)
devtools::load_all()
```

Correct tables with wide format where each column is a congener
```{r}

sheets.mod <- c("wright_2008_2","ross_et_al_2013_b")

googlesheets4::gs4_deauth()
pcb.conc <- "1zmYEiVVxarWLrcy2x-qMKs6-mlwCrC7P3saNnv6EPlQ"
sp.sheet <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(pcb.conc, sheet=sheets.mod[1])
names(sp.sheet)
sp.sheet.mod <- sp.sheet %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = (tidyr::starts_with("PCB")), names_to="congener", values_to="value") %>% 
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cols="congener", delim = "B", names = c("pc", "no_congener")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-pc, -TOC)

readr::write_csv(sp.sheet.mod, here::here("data",paste0(sheets.mod[1],".csv")))


googlesheets4::gs4_deauth()
pcb.conc <- "1zmYEiVVxarWLrcy2x-qMKs6-mlwCrC7P3saNnv6EPlQ"
sp.sheet <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(pcb.conc, sheet=sheets.mod[2])
names(sp.sheet)
sp.sheet.mod <- sp.sheet %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = (tidyr::starts_with("PCB")), names_to="congener", values_to="value") %>% 
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cols="congener", delim = "B", names = c("pc", "no_congener")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-pc)

readr::write_csv(sp.sheet.mod, here::here("data",paste0(sheets.mod[2],".csv")))

```


```{r}
sheets.mod <- c("bolton_unpublished")

googlesheets4::gs4_deauth()
pcb.conc <- "1zmYEiVVxarWLrcy2x-qMKs6-mlwCrC7P3saNnv6EPlQ"
sp.sheet <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(pcb.conc, sheet=sheets.mod[1])
names(sp.sheet)

sp.sheet.mod <- sp.sheet %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = "17":"tot_pcb", names_to="PCB_congener", values_to="concentration")  %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(atlantis_polygon=as.character(atlantis_polygon)) %>% 
  tidyr::unnest(cols = "atlantis_polygon") %>% 
  dplyr::select(functional_group, common_name, sample_id, concentration, value, everything())

readr::write_csv(sp.sheet.mod, here::here("data",paste0(sheets.mod[1],".csv")))




```
